title: Mental health
reading: Many people suffer from various mental health problems over the course of their lives. There are many reasons why people develop mental health problems. Sometimes, they are due to difficult life situations such as family problems or a difficult work situation. Some people develop mental problems after a crisis, death or accident or as a result of war experiences. Some people may have a hereditary predisposition to develop mental disorders, and stress can act as a trigger.

We may need to talk to someone when we are struggling. Sometimes it’s enough to talk to family or friends. While, at other times, we may need professional help. A psychologist or another expert can often help us to find solutions to our problems. Regular GPs can refer patients to a psychologist if they need it.

How society views mental health has changed. Today, a majority of the Norwegian population has an open and understanding attitude to mental illness. Most people believe that the mentally ill should be given treatment and help by the health service in the same way as people with physical problems. We also believe that it is possible to be cured of mental illnesses.
discussion: Talk together Talk about views on mental health at different times and in different societies. What can we do to ensure we have good mental health? GettyImages GettyImages
exercises: Select the right answer What do most people in Norway think about mental illness? That people who are mentally ill should not get help until everyone who is physically ill has received help. That people who are mentally ill must get treatment and help on a par with people who are physically ill. Select the right answer Who develops mental problems? Everyone can develop mental problems, for a variety of reasons. People aged between 18 and 30 can develop mental problems, and they do so because they have a hereditary predisposition. People who are stressed can develop mental illnesses, and they do so because they are going through something difficult. Select the right answer What can your regular GP do if you need someone to talk to? Ask their friends about what you should do. Refer you to a psychologist. Tell you to fix your problems yourself. Select the right answer How can poor mental health affect us? It can affect us physically, in that we find it difficult to sleep or develop a stomach ache. It only affects our mood and how we look at life. Select right or wrong Read the statements. What is right? What is wrong?
